subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] OpenClaw WebChat: Conversation Management & Multi-AI Collaboration

question: Should this remain the broad canonical core tracker, and which remaining WebChat project-directory and multi-AI collaboration pieces belong in core versus narrower Projects, topic-family, plugin, or ClawHub work?
rationale: Current main satisfies many session-management primitives, while the remaining request crosses persisted state, Gateway protocol, Control UI UX, memory boundaries, and heavy orchestration direction that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Split
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and ask maintainers to define separate milestones for project/session metadata, directory navigation, and multi-agent collaboration semantics.

options.title: Narrow To Session UX
options.body: Limit near-term core work to existing session grouping, search, pin/archive/rename, switching, and split panes while leaving committee/project-tracking workflows out of scope for now.

options.title: Defer Collaboration To Extensions
options.body: Treat advanced multi-AI committee workflows as plugin, ACP, or ClawHub prototypes until a smaller core API gap is proven.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Split
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and ask maintainers to define separate milestones for project/session metadata, directory navigation, and multi-agent collaboration semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They already gave the canonical-tracker signal and are the strongest recent history signal across adjacent Control UI/session surfaces.
